intro.text: Kiin and Daora's young son, Kaise's brother and Sarene's cousin.
Kiin and Daora's young son, Sarene's cousin, who is forever trying to keep up with his clever sister Kaise.

items.text: Arriving in Kae, Sarene met her young cousins Kaise and Daorn at Kiin's house. During the meal Daorn grumbled that the JinDo food was too spicy, told Sarene that their father was Teo too, and offered her a spoon when she struggled with the eating sticks. He was amazed to find she had a seon.

At dinner the next night Daorn tried hard to seem more grown-up than his sister, telling her to stop showing off. When Kaise claimed the prince had been waiting to marry her, he shot back that Raoden had married Sarene instead. Both children hated the nickname Lukel gave them, 'the twins', not least because they looked nothing alike.

Daorn and Kaise took Sarene up onto the wall of Elantris, where they found Hrathen preaching. Daorn stayed dutifully by her side, and afterwards told her he disliked the gyorn for being too hard, and that Kiin feared hard times would make people listen to him. Looking down into the city, he explained that nobody fed the Elantrians.

Daorn and Kaise tagged along to Sarene's first fencing lesson, squabbling over chairs and a stolen practice stick. Lukel felt sorry for Daorn: the boy tried his best, but his domineering sister probably left him feeling inadequate.

When Dilaf's monks attacked Kae, Daorn sheltered in Kiin's mansion with Kaise, Adien and Jalla. Once Sarene was captured, the family was rounded up and marched towards Elantris with those who were to be burned, and Daorn and Kaise clung to Lukel in terror.

personality.text: Daorn is earnest and dutiful and eager to seem grown-up. He tries his best, though his quick-witted, bossy sister often outshines him.
